description: Preview an order against combined portfolio position, gross, concentration, daily-loss, reserve, and leverage limits. No order is placed; call preview_order separately for venue fees, minimums, collateral, liquidity, and slippage.

account_id.description: Optional owned child account UUID. Omit for the active account.

allow_leverage.description: Set true only after reviewing collateral. Omitted or false blocks orders whose notional exceeds free Hyperliquid collateral.

instrument.description: Instrument, e.g. BTC, NVDA, lighter:ETH, option:BTC-20260711-70000-C, pm:<slug>.

size_usd.description: Dollar notional to spend or trade.

name: preview_portfolio_order
